title: Koman languages - Wikipedia
text: The Koman languages are a small, close-knit family of languages located along the Ethiopia–Sudan border with about 50,000 speakers. They are conventionally classified as part of the Nilo-Saharan family.Komo (Sudan) — about 12,000 speakers mainly in An Nil al Azraq.

title: Komo language - Wikipedia
text: Many individuals from Komo are multilingual because they are in close proximity to Mao, Kwama and Oromo speakers. Komo is closely related to Kwama, a language spoken by a group who live in the same region of Ethiopia and who also identify themselves as ethnically Komo.
